mapper.select: SELECT u.display_name,u.phone,ep.* FROM engineer_profile ep JOIN system_user u ON u.user_id=ep.engineer_id WHERE ep.engineer_id=#{engineerId}

SELECT f.fault_type_id,f.name,CASE WHEN s.engineer_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END selected FROM fault_type f LEFT JOIN engineer_skill s ON s.fault_type_id=f.fault_type_id AND s.engineer_id=#{engineerId} WHERE f.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY f.name

SELECT a.service_area_id,a.name,CASE WHEN e.engineer_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END selected FROM service_area a LEFT JOIN engineer_service_area e ON e.service_area_id=a.service_area_id AND e.engineer_id=#{engineerId} WHERE a.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY a.name
mapper.update: UPDATE system_user SET phone=#{phone} WHERE user_id=#{engineerId}
UPDATE engineer_profile SET bio=#{bio} WHERE engineer_id=#{engineerId}
